dealbreakers.why: The quote 'excluding the near-term impact of our recent acquisitions' is not character for character in mdna:110, which reads 'Excluding the near-term impact of our recent acquisitions'; the first letter's case differs and the rubric excepts only whitespace.
'The headquarters leases were extended by twelve years' states a lease term in the analyst's own words, outside any quote of notes:139, and no calculator path supplies it.

It reports the 8-K header and item list as inconsistent, but input_8k.md's own header says 'so this bundle has no earnings release and no verbatim item body' and the notes-text reader read it the same way: the release is indexed and its body is absent.
'intangible amortization on lives of up to fourteen years' restates a useful life from notes:79 in the analyst's own words; no calculator path supplies it.
The area finding carries the same altered quote, 'excluding the near-term impact of our recent acquisitions', against the capitalised 'Excluding' in mdna:110.

'the index itself is inconsistent about whether it exists' leaves open what input_8k.md settles (the earnings-release filing is indexed, its body is not in the bundle); areas.controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding repeats the same reading.
'holds under three months of it' states a duration in the analyst's own words that no calculator path supplies.
'Roughly double the best fiscal-year operating margin on record' and 'about triple the three-year average' are multiples the analyst computed; the calculator supplies neither.

coverage.why: The gate dropped the accounting area cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sheet and the financial sections liquidity and solvency (each file's dropped_items), so those answers are missing.

calibration.why: The estimates_and_reserves verdict calls the allowance decline an income-raising estimate change, though its anomaly is unresolved and sizes no release; cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sheet lists anomalies under an area whose finding and verdict were dropped.

valuation_reading.why: The price_position and market_implied_growth readings were dropped for citing the non-numeric fields valuation.price_position and valuation.reverse_dcf.held, so valuation.reverse_dcf.value is never read; of the two sensitive assumptions, only WACC is varied in valuation.sensitivity.grid.
